headline: Sensex surges 800 points as IT stocks lead market rebound, Nifty nears 22,500

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Stock markets rebounded sharply in early trade led by strong buying in TCS and IT stocks.
All sectoral indices turned green, providing broad-based support to the benchmark indices.
India VIX dropped 5%, signaling reduced volatility in the market.
The Indian Rupee strengthened by 23 paise against the U.S. dollar in early trade.
whatHappening: Sensex surged around 800 points and Nifty reached near the 22,500 mark.
Hexaware Technologies jumped 11% after announcing a multi-year pact with Anthropic.
NCC stock rose 5% following a Rs 1,286 crore road project order win in Telangana.
Gold and silver prices rose sharply ahead of key US economic data.
summary: Indian benchmark indices rebounded strongly on October 9 as Sensex surged nearly 800 points and Nifty approached 22,500. Gains were primarily driven by the IT sector, led by TCS, with all sectoral indices trading in the green. Volatility eased as VIX dropped 5%, while stocks like Hexaware and NCC registered notable gains on company-specific announcements.
